subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this umbrella remain canonical until the Anthropic signed-thinking prevention work lands, or should maintainers close it in favor of the narrower open issues now that recovery is on main?
rationale: Current main fixes the recovery carrier and durable transcript repair, but the remaining prevention choice changes Anthropic replay semantics and is already represented by multiple open focused issues and PRs.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad production-evidence tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or the cluster is formally split.

options.title: Make Focused Issues Canonical
options.body: Close this issue as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94228 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 after posting a clear handoff.

options.title: Recovery-Only Closure
options.body: Close this issue as implemented for recovery only and require new reports for any remaining prevention variants.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad production-evidence tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or the cluster is formally split.

likelyOwner.reason: He already routed the recovery half in the issue discussion and appears in the merged recovery history, making him the best available owner for the canonical-cluster choice.
